title: Client token claims, v1
description: The body of a client token: a JWT (HS256) the host signs with one of its project's signing keys and hands to its browser pages. Only the host holds the key, so the browser cannot change a claim. The HMAC key is the secret part of MYBEAST_ERRORS_SIGNING_KEY (after the first dot) as a UTF-8 string, not decoded. Header: client-token-header.schema.json.

sub.description: The person: the host's own user id. Never a name or an e-mail.

acct.description: The account (workspace, organisation) they work in now, or null.

env.description: The host's environment: production, staging, local, …

rec.description: This page may be recorded: the person said yes and the host allows it here.

mask.description: Recordings are masked in the browser; the service scans them for leaks.

consent_at.description: When the person said yes to recording, unix milliseconds. A chunk from before it is refused. Required when rec is true.

internal.description: Staff, demo or test account of the host: never counted, never alerted about.

test.description: A synthetic account: its recordings may be exported for the host's masking canary.

exp.description: Expires at, unix seconds; at most 3600 after iat (SDKs mint 1800).
